text_block_list.text:
It happened one day during a long break
after the Arima Kinen had finished.
On the desk across the room, dozens of manga borrowed from Kiseki were piled up high. And—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Did you finish reading it...?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I just finished...!
Yeah, I just finished...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!
Congratulations on finishing 'The Drift Hunt'!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With this, finally!
We can go on that hot spring trip!!
choice_data_list: Yeah...!

text_block_list.text:
The grand prize won from the shopping district raffle: a "Hot Springs Trip Voucher."
Apparently, the inn is the setting of a manga Kiseki loves.

And since I had the chance, I even
borrowed some manga from Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you actually read it...!
Even though it's a massive epic with over 100 volumes...!
choice_data_list: That way we can enjoy the trip to the fullest.
That way we can enjoy the trip to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, Trainer-san...!
choice_data_list: Alright! Let's go while the memory's still fresh!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...! The real thing...!

Kiseki clasps her hands together and looks up at the inn.
It's just like the scene where the sub-heroine, Mutsumi, makes her entrance in volume 34 of the manga "Nagare no Kari."

I was puzzled by how vividly I could remember events from the manga.
Was this the result of that manga training camp?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ? Is something the matter?
choice_data_list: They said your mannerisms are just like Mutsumi's...
They said your mannerisms remind me of Mutsumi...

text_block_list.name: Mutsumi
text_block_list.text: “...Do you believe in destiny?”
choice_data_list: That's Mutsumi's line!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...! Correct, absolutely correct!!
So then, how did Nagare reply to that!?

I recall manga panels in my head, trying to drag up lines the characters said.
If I remember right, the protagonist Nagare said...
choice_data_list: "I'll believe it when the world ends tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Waaah, ding-dong ding-dooong!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Genius?! Incredible!
You're officially a 'Nagare-maniac'!
choice_data_list: Nagare Mania...!?

text_block_list.text:
Does this mean she acknowledges me as a fellow comrade
worthy of discussing manga with?
choice_data_list: W-Well then, can I give you a quiz too?
W-Well then, can I give you a quiz too?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sounds good~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Once the quiz is over,
let's go take photos matching the manga panels!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Today is Manga Mania Day for the whole day!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Look here!!
This is the window shown when Nagare and Master were talking!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
Over here's got an autograph from the author!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Trainer!
Why don't we buy that wooden sword over there!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*...
This is baaad...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Today feels just like a dream...!
choice_data_list: It's not a dream!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right!
...Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...And I don't wanna leave it as just a dream either.
choice_data_list: Because it's real, it'll make for a great memory.
Because it's real, it'll make for a great memory.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It is just as you say.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll go get some hot water.
What about you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'll relax a little longer before I head out.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
...Well then, I'll be going ahead.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Phew... Such a nice scent...
And the stars are so pretty...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Are you still in your room, Trainer?
You were looking pretty exhausted, after all."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Going out of your way to read all the manga volumes,
and playing along with my silly antics..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...What a kind person.

“...Bright light filters through the cracks of my eyelids.
It seems I had fallen asleep.”
choice_data_list: Huh, where's Kiseki...

text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if she's relaxing
in her room too."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: Oh, Kiseki. There you are.
Huh, Kiseki. So this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I wanted to see the night scenery as well.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, did you just wake up?
choice_data_list: Well, something like that...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's no wonder you're tired.
You've been dragged around by me since morning, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
please don't push yourself too hard.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Because, you're the kind of Trainer
who'd go all out going along with my hobbies, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you keep being nice like that all the time,
you're going to burn out eventually.
choice_data_list: You don't need to be that considerate...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so-?
choice_data_list: Because I'm going along with this precisely because it's a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh.
choice_data_list: I figured that spending time with you would definitely be fun.
I figured that if I spent time with you, it'd definitely be a blast.

text_block_list.text:
I look back on the days I've spent with Kiseki so far.
Every day with her has been truly wonderful.
choice_data_list: So from here on out, with you—
So from here on out, with you—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey!
Trainer?!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Putting it that way is a bit... embarrassing.
choice_data_list: Why? I always praise you for being funny, don't I?
Why? I always praise you for being funny, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's true, but... Man...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... What is this feeling?
Maybe I'm just a little too happy...

It was a moment where
I felt an irreplaceable bond
with Kiseki...
